ModMetaData.name: RimMT 2.0 M1.1.5 - Rolling Caller Census

ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.6 multithreading foundation using ManagedJob and JobHandle. M1.1 adds opt-in sampled WorkGiver search attribution to identify a worthwhile first parallel workload. The spatial snapshot proof remains disabled by default.
